book.name: Zân
book.title: Zân Zisasiyet yaŋaŋ Zânaŋ meluwaŋ mge.

content: Zisasiyaŋ an 5000 bepi tu meu indame nimbien
Zisasiyaŋ zet kegok zeme delaŋ zeme Galili tundua kwitnaŋ ŋen Taibilias manzemtemien tundua ke somti nembet daeset mebenn.
Mepmann animbi sambe ekŋenaŋ Zisasiyaŋ animbi zawatmak ma wesiŋ mee pi taweyaŋindeme ekmambiengapmti keyegak ndamâti mebien.
Âpme Zisasmak nin nembet moti ndatimti kalaŋ dukŋan gwaenen moti totapmambenn.
Kan keyet Zuda am ekŋengalen Aŋgalaŋ Kendo sokŋan beye.
Âpme Zisasiyaŋ am maŋge temaŋ penaŋ kwaweti weme indikti egaŋ Pilip pigok yaŋkwesiye, “Pilip, am maŋge temaŋ penaŋ kapi nupmamaŋ desetgat penaŋ kwitimti am sambe kapi indamann nseip?”
(Zisasiyaŋ, “Kwitnaŋ kwitnaŋ zigok msap e nâmtati,” Pilipgat belak tetipem ege.)
Âpme Piliwaŋ wa penaŋ penaŋ zep mene zemti pigok zeye, “Nin mânep 200 Kina bukapiyaŋ meu kwitimti am maŋge temaŋ bekapi indamann isiksik bugan munzuti nseip mene.”
Zeme Zisasiyet nembaŋaŋ ŋen Endulu Saimon Pitayet datnaŋ egaŋ Zisasiyet pigok dunduye,
“Zisas, anemba ŋenaŋ nupmamaŋaŋ 5 ma aŋgalaŋaŋ zut etaŋ eleŋan weti tapme ekti aikolap. Âpme am sambe kamendepmaŋ bekaboŋ bekapi bukapi zigok munzutindamann ŋep benak?”
Zeme nâmti Zisasiyaŋ ningat pigok dinndoye, “In am ekŋen zemindeme sutnakwep totalit.” Zeme nin am zemindemann kwaŋ sinaŋ yati gwilelaŋ totabien an 5000. Âpme imbimak nembamak ekŋen ku indamakukuŋaŋ.
Zisasiyaŋ nupmamaŋ ke mti Kawawaŋgat wisikŋ zemti mutumti am tapmebienen indaye. Mti aŋgala sepem kegogak meselemti am kalaŋti indamepme nimâbien.
Meu nimkiŋgapme temepme Zisasiyaŋ ningat pigok dinndoye, “Nime meu butnaŋ totemelep e belak wemti walesemmagengat akume maŋge kwep molak.”
Âpme nin nupmamaŋ 5 etaŋ bukapiwan Zisasiyaŋ mme sambe beme nimwiaŋme butnaŋ temege. Pi timti tise 12 kapi wepme gak zeye.
Âpme am ekŋenaŋ Zisasiyaŋ menok ke mme ekti pigok zewien, “Kawawaŋmagen golaŋ zenze an temaŋ msalen pi sokbembeyet zenzeŋaŋ kelak an ikŋaŋ kapimak!”
Zemti Zisas atamti amobotnaŋin onzempesâgât tazenâme egaŋ wak kambu nâmti nâme ŋep kumbeme igak buzak kalaŋan mowege.
Zisasiyaŋ tundua paleset mege

Msat ilak gasi penaŋ beme nembaŋane nin nnak tundua ganzenan toti waŋga ŋen mti Kapaneam mka msalen daen mesât nâmti towebenn. Towepmann msat tambuyeyepmtilak Zisas ke tapme nnak waŋga ŋen mti mebenn.
Tapmepmann tâgâ omba penaŋ kumbume tundua mamaŋ omba penaŋ takume ekmambe tapmepmambenn.
Nin waŋgaen moti ilak beŋan daen tu sutnan
kegok tapmepmann Zisasiyaŋ kalaŋangatnan toti nembu paleset ninmagen sokŋanik tapmepme nin ekti, “Wa! we eknup,” zemti kiŋgabenn.
Kegok mmann ndikti kwizet kumti zeye, “Neŋ nen takolapgat in ku kiŋgalit.”
Zemti met pataŋ zeme nin betnamann waŋgaen molak zem tapminepeme waŋgayaŋ ilak msat mesât nâmti mebiennen ke met sakwep metage.
Am ekŋenaŋ Zisasiyet timabien
Animbi sambe ekŋenaŋ tundua nembet daen tatnepeme msat msame zewien, “Saŋen tambuyet waŋga kwewetaŋ tapme ekmenn elak Zisaspiŋ nembaŋaneyaŋ etaŋ moti mepme indikmen.”
Kegok zemti tatnepeme waŋga notnaŋ Taibilias mkaesetgatnan Amobotnaŋ Zisasiyaŋ Bipmaŋgat wisikŋ zeme tu meu sambe sokbeme amnaŋ nimwiaŋbien keeset kot pataŋ zemâbien.
Âpme am ekŋenaŋ Zisas ma nin ndatimati naman waŋga keyet moti Kapaneam mka msalen meti tokwat ndatimabien.
Timat meti met ndaaikti Zisasiyet zewien, “An zikat indanda, geŋ zukŋan tu nembet daengatnan kopmanan?”

Yaŋkwesime zet kapigok diindoye, “Neŋ zet penaŋ sukwep zema nâit: Neŋ menok windeŋaŋbeŋ inmagen mamiyap keyet nâmkiŋpemnemti ku kolo yek. In meu sambe penaŋ aikindama nimti ekmien keyepmti nâgât tatokwatnatimalip.

In kwitnaŋ kwitnaŋ walebe keyet mulupmaŋ ku mbep. Mama katikŋaŋ keyelen meu keyet mulupmaŋ weyaŋ mbep. Mama katikŋaŋgalen meu ke Angat Nemuŋaŋaŋ neŋ indandayet Kawawaŋaŋ ikŋaŋ nâmneme ŋep beme zemdelaŋ zemneŋge.”
Zeme zet dopmaŋ pigok gilik zemti sawien, “Nin mulup pe ziboŋ ke mmann Kawawaŋaŋ ningat nâme dolakŋaŋ bewe.”
Yaŋkwesime pigok diindoye, “An Kawawaŋaŋ zempeme koge ke nâmkiŋpewep keyaŋ muluwin ŋotekŋaŋ penaŋ bein.”
Zeme ekŋenaŋ zet pigok dunduwien, “Geŋ pe menok ziboŋ penaŋ mmane ekti nâmkiŋpemgewanup? Ma geŋ pe mulup ziboŋ penaŋ mbanigat tazenik?

Nin yeŋsokŋne ekŋenaŋ msat tuŋgupman meu piŋan mamti meuŋin kululuŋengatnaŋ topme nimti mambien. Keyet Kawawaŋgalen Zet Itnaŋanen pigok meluwaŋ mamaiŋ nânup, ‘Kawawaŋaŋ meu kululuŋengatnaŋ aikindame manimtemien.’”

Âpme Zisasiyaŋ pigok diindoye, “Neŋ zet penaŋ diindoma nâit: Moses egaŋ meu kululuŋengatnaŋ penaŋ ke ku indaye. Mosesiyaŋ Bien Kawawaŋgat dundume Bienaŋ kululuŋengatnaŋ meu ke belak sekŋin etaŋ bandim mimiyet maindamkwatan. Âpme alak meu penaŋ ke Kawawaŋaŋ ikŋaŋ am indapmukulem penaŋ mimiyet nâmti kululuŋengatnan peme toti alak ingat tuŋguwinan kapi tazin.
Meu kululuŋengatnaŋaŋ toti am mama maaikindain ke Kawawaŋmagen meu penaŋ elak kapi tazin.”
Zeme ekŋenaŋ zewien, “Amobotnaŋ, geŋ meu zenik ke nin manndamambanik.”
Zeme dopmaŋ pigok diindoye, “Mamayelen meu elak neŋ kapimak. Am ŋenaŋ neŋmagen wetekumti mambe beme egaŋ meuyet ku mbe. Ma am ŋenaŋ neŋ nâmkiŋpemnewe beme egaŋ kegogak tuyet ku atowe.
Neŋ pigok diindoma nâit: in neŋ zikalinaŋ ke niktiŋgut ewe ku manâmkiŋpemneip.
Bienaŋ am nâmindeme neŋmagen makolip ekŋen ke neŋ ŋep ku zemindema mebep.
Neŋ kululuŋen gwaengatnan toban e wa msalen kapi nanaŋgat nânânnaŋgat etaŋ mamayet ku toban. An zemneme toban egalen zet gawepumti keyet kataŋ mamayet toban.

Bienaŋ am nâmdelaŋ zemti nâlen belen bemindeye. Ekŋen ke maneti walelet aikbiekmagengapm neŋ indikdamuŋ dolakŋaŋ mti maneti bam kobawen ekŋen ke ilindiŋ gakikiengatnan mamaen mkwatindewap. An zemneme toban egalen nânâ ilak zeya kegok.
Am neŋ nikmâtâti manâmkiŋpemneip ekŋen bam gakikiengatnan mwat indema mama kanzizit keyet toŋaŋ bewep. Biengalen nânâŋaŋ kegok penaŋ tazin.”
Zisasiyaŋ “Neŋ meu kululuŋengatnaŋ” zeye keyepmti Zuda am ekŋenaŋ nâme bekanaŋ beme zet mmot mtot sambe penaŋ mbien.
Mti pigok zewien, “Zisas pi mamaŋ bipmaŋ Zosep ma Malia e nâmidenup. Âpme naman egaŋ zigoset neŋ kululuŋengatnan kwatoban pi tazein?”
Zemti ilinak zet ŋunuŋ ŋunuŋ tapmmepme Zisasiyaŋ indikti pigok diindoye, “In zet ŋunuŋ ŋunuŋ peme talak.

Nâip, an ŋenaŋ ikŋaŋgat keŋaŋgalak neŋmagen kokot ke ŋep ku tazin. Bienaŋ an ke nâmpemeŋgut ŋep neŋmagen kokogalen. Âpme neŋ an neŋmagen kobe ke maneti bam kokot kananen koti gakikiengatnan mwat pewap.
Golaŋ zenze an egaŋ Kawawaŋgalen Zet Itnaŋanen pigok meluwaŋ mbien,

content.text: ‘Kawawaŋaŋ ikŋaŋ am sambe ikŋaŋgat yaŋaŋ zemkawaŋ bemindawe.’ (Aizaya 54:13)

content: Keyepmti an ŋenaŋ Biengalen zet ke nâmti keyet kataŋ mambe egaŋ neŋmagen kobe.
An ŋeŋaŋ Bien sepemaŋ bugan ku ege yek penaŋ. Neŋ Kawawaŋmagengatnan toban neŋ etaŋ gulak nâmpeyap.
Neŋ zet penaŋ pigok diindoma nâit: An ŋenaŋ neŋ nâmkiŋpemnewe beme egaŋ mama kanzizit tiwe.
Mamayelen meu e neŋ.
Yeŋsokŋine ekŋenaŋ msat tuŋgupman mamti meuŋin meu kululuŋengatnaŋ manimtemien yaŋgut gakimâpme delaŋ zeye.
Âpme meu kululuŋengatnan kwatoge ke an ŋenaŋ nimbe beme egaŋ ŋep ku gakiwe.

Mama keyelen meu kululuŋengatnan toge elak nen kapi. Keyepmti an ŋenaŋ meu kululuŋengatnan tototnaŋ ke nimbe beme ek mama kanzizit mameti mambe. Sesumban keyaŋ meunok bein ke msat sambe am indama nime keyaŋ mama kanzizit aikindaweyet indawap.”
Âpme Zuda am ekŋenaŋ ke nâmti ilinak ŋenzinziŋ mti zewien, “An kapiyaŋ zigoset ikŋaŋgat sesumbanaŋ munzut ndame nin niniyet tazein?”
Tazenâme Zisasiyaŋ indikti pigok diindoye, “Neŋ penaŋ sukwep penaŋ pigok zema nâit: In nâgât sesumbann ma sipm ke ku nimbep beme in mama kanzizit ku tiwep.
An ŋenaŋ nâlen sip sesumbann nimbe beme egaŋ mama kanzizitgat zapat bemti mame neŋ kobawen ek gakikiengatnan mima wabe.
Nâlen sip sesumbann ke tu meu nemboŋ penaŋ
keyepmti an ŋenaŋ nâgât sipm sesumbann ke nimbe beme egaŋ neŋmak tusuwe. Âpme neŋ ekmak tususu dolakŋaŋ mti mambalup.

Bien Kawawaŋ ek mama toŋaŋ egaŋ ikŋaŋ zemneme toban. Neŋ ekmak mamayap keyepmti neŋ mama kanzizit timtalap. Kegogapm an ŋenaŋ neŋ natnimbe beme egaŋ nâgât pembenaŋnnaŋgat mti mama kanzizit timti mamambe.

Meu kululuŋengatnan toge wa e yeŋsokŋineyaŋ msat tuŋgupman mamti meu manimtemien sepem keboŋ yek. Ekŋenaŋ meu ke timti manimkwatemienaŋgut gakim mâbien. Âpme an ŋenaŋ nâlen meu zeyap kapi nimbe beme egaŋ gakikipiŋ kwesiŋ kwesiŋ mameti mambe.”
Zisasiyaŋ Kapaneam sesewat mkaen am Zet Zapat Dolakŋaŋ tazemzikat indametneti ikŋaŋgat zet zapatnaŋ kapi zeye.
Am notnaŋaŋ Zisasiyet nâme wisat beme bamkumpemti mebien
Am notnaŋ ek mâti mamtemien ekŋenaŋ zetnaŋ ke nâmti pigok zewien, “Zet kapi pe zeme nâmann keŋŋ penaŋ ku bein. Zet keboŋ ke an kwiyaŋ ŋep apumti zenak?”
Zemti wisat zet mme Zisasiyaŋ keŋinan baen indikmâtâti pigok diindoye, “In zet zeya keyet nâme keŋin penaŋ ku beme wisat mnemti mesât tatnâip!
Âpme in tati ekme Angat Nemuŋaŋ neŋ gilik zemti naman mundumnan maneti tobanen keyegak mowepma in ke ekti pe zigok nâmbep?

Nin mambipmmagen masokbenup ke ekŋenaŋ mama msat palen kapi mamayelen mme masokbenup keyaŋgulak Kawawaŋgalen Emetak Teŋaŋ mama alakŋaŋ titiyelen keŋnan mam mme sokbein. Keyepmti neŋ zet zeya ke Kawawaŋgalen zet in mama indandayelen ke diindoya. Âpme an ŋenaŋ zet ke nâmkiŋpewe beme egaŋ Emetak Teŋaŋ mama kanzizit ke same mamambe.

Âpme inmagen am notnaŋaŋ zet keyet nâme penaŋepiŋ beme ku nâmkiŋpeyo.” (Zisasiyaŋ am zet zapatnaŋ dolakŋaŋ kapi bamkumpewep ma maneti bam an zemkuwe e mee eweŋanak indikmâtâpme mamamtemien keyepmti egaŋ zet kegok diindoye.)
Mti zet butnaŋ ŋen pigok tusum zeye, “Neŋ kegogapmti eweŋan pigok diindoya an ŋen Bienaŋ keŋaŋ mim eleŋ beleŋ bembepiŋ mme egaŋ igak nânâŋak nâlen ŋep ku kobe.”
Zeme kan keyet am notnaŋ ekŋen Zisas mâti mamamtemien ekŋenaŋ ewe mâti mamayet wisat mti bamkumpemti mepmâbien.
Âpme Zisasiyaŋ nembaŋane 12 nin pigok ndayaŋkwesiye, “In am notnaŋaŋ tapmelip kegogak nemti mesât tatnâip?”
Zeme Saimon Pitayaŋ pigok zeye, “Amobotnaŋŋ, nin geŋ gemti naman kwimagen mebanup? Mama katikŋaŋ titiyelen zetnaŋ geŋ etaŋ manzemâtâtndamane nânup.
Nin geŋmak mamti pigok manânup geŋ Kawawaŋgat Nemuŋaŋ teŋ penaŋ e nâmgemti manâmkiŋpemgenup.”
Zeme Zisasiyaŋ nin pigok dinndoye, “Neŋ nemba in 12 kapi indatimamayap yaŋgut ingat tuŋguwinaŋgatnaŋ ŋen Sadaŋmak mamain.”
Egaŋ Zudas Saimongat nemuŋaŋ Iskaliot mkaengatnan keyet nâmti zeye. Zudas ke nemba 12 ninmagengatnaŋ an ŋen ilak ke. Yaŋ maneti an keyaŋ Zisas zemkuwe.
